items.reason: offset accumulates exactly the DashPrefix strip's removed prefix (emDashIndex+1 plus post-dash TrimStart whitespace) and nothing else; costPartStart and effectSpan both add offset consistently, and the effectSpan length formula (RawText.Length - offset - (colonIndex+1)) correctly re-pins the end to clause end; hand-recomputed for all 6 cards and every byte offset matches the fixture output exactly.

paren-wrap + dash-prefix combination is structurally impossible: IsParentheticalActivatedAbility requires the paren-stripped inner text to match ^\{[^}]+\}: immediately (no room for a 'Word — ' prefix inside), and TryExtractAbilityWord does an exact-match lookup of clause.RawText[..emDashIndex].Trim() against the ability-word/printed-label sets, which a leading '(' character always breaks — so no real card shape is left unhandled by scoping the offset fix to DashPrefix only.
